description: This file defines the SavingsAccountTransactionTaxDetails class, representing tax details associated with a savings account transaction in the Fineract system. It includes mappings to database tables and relationships to other domain entities such as TaxComponent and SavingsAccountTransaction.

classes.name: SavingsAccountTransactionTaxDetails
classes.description: Entity class representing the tax details of a savings account transaction, including references to the transaction itself, the tax component, and the amount of tax applied.

methods.name: SavingsAccountTransactionTaxDetails
methods.description: Constructor to initialize the tax details with a transaction, tax component, and amount.

methods.name: getTaxComponent
methods.description: Returns the TaxComponent associated with this tax detail.

methods.name: getAmount
methods.description: Returns the amount of tax applied.

methods.name: updateAmount
methods.description: Updates the tax amount using a Money object.
